## Code Review

This pull request implements a guest bootstrap runtime-directory remediation, updating the golden image SHA-256 hash across configuration, documentation, and validation files, and adding RuntimeDirectory configurations to the systemd service. Additionally, the golden image build script is updated to capture preflight failures earlier. The review feedback highlights two key improvements: first, in Build-GoldenImage.ps1, the error handling in the trap block should be restructured to prevent secondary filesystem errors from masking the original error and to avoid terminating interactive hosts with exit; second, in validate-bundle.mjs, the newly read bootstrap service file should be added to the requiredFiles array to ensure missing files are handled gracefully without throwing unhandled exceptions.
